Future<void> repeated(dynamic items) async {
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
  for (var i = 0; i < 4; await save(i), i++) {}
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
  for (var i = 0; await more(i); i++) ;
  for (var i = 0, n = items.length, last = n - 1; i < n; i++) {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    await save(items[i]);
  }
  var i = 0;
  for (; i < items.length; i++) {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    await save(items[i]);
  }
  for (var i = items.length; i-- > 0;) {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    await save(items[i]);
  }
  for (var i = 0; i < 4; handlers.add(() async => await save(i)), i++) {}
  for (var i = 0; i < 4; i++) {}
}
